CustomField.description: When checked, clients belonging to the onboarding audience (Data Cloud segment SEG_PL_UC2_CLIENT-ONBOARDING-FLAGS) should be excluded from this campaign. The wizard captures this intent; the actual exclusion is enforced downstream by the Data Cloud segment/activation layer.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to remove clients currently in the onboarding phase from this campaign's audience. Enforced by the downstream activation layer.
CustomField.label: Exclude Onboarding
